title: Better Wool Bedwars
description: A Simple Bedwars texture pack with simple block textures for fps boosting and better wool place noises
body:
⭐ Better Wool Bedwars
A lightweight Bedwars texture pack built for high FPS and a smooth gameplay experience.

🔹 Simplified block textures for reduced visual noise
Smaller swords and tools for clearer combat visibility
Minimal particles for cleaner fights

🔊 Enhanced wool‑placing sounds for faster bridging
Cleaner, sharper in‑game effects

🎮 Made for Bedwars Players
Perfect for fast bridging, clutching, PvP, and overall smoother gameplay.
